items.question: Over what period are the interest-free loans from the Sheikh Zayed Housing Programme repayable?
items.fact: SZHP interest-free loans repayable over 25 years

items.question: How many structurally and architecturally pre-approved housing designs does the Abu Dhabi Housing Authority's 'Bayti' initiative provide?
items.fact: Bayti initiative provides 58 pre-approved housing designs
